_about: Public-domain Job Scott (1751-1793), Quaker minister of Providence, Rhode Island, for the Word Hoard: his Journal (New York, 1797), his Works (Philadelphia, 1831, two volumes), The Baptism of Christ a Gospel Ordinance (Providence, 1793) and Essays on Salvation by Christ (1894), from Internet Archive scans. Not Thomas Scott or Walter Scott. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
